protocol.task: one Runtime agent per question; extract each required document into private segments, then answer
protocol.single_factor: SemanticRecoveryPolicy.restore_context; all other dirty/snapshot configuration identical
protocol.injection: first attempt only; execution after K extractions; semantic adds a false private fact, calls answer, then overrides returned answer
protocol.source_order: source question required_refs order; retries restart full extraction
protocol.scoring: strict experiment A JSON and AST expression normalization
